title: Phones, apps & payments
goal: Pay by UPI, order online and track deliveries, deal with failed payments and dead Wi-Fi, stay safe from scams, and talk about posts, reels and likes.
intro:
Tech talk in Odia is English words with Odia grammar: **ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହୋଇଗଲା** 'the payment went through', **ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ କର** 'download the app', **ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ଚାଲୁନି** 'the internet's not working'. The trick is choosing the right Odia verb to go with the English word — **କରିବା** when someone does it, **ହେବା** when it just happens.

You'll also use the **-ଲେ** conditional from unit 19 the way people really do, all day long: **ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଫେଲ୍ ହେଲେ** 'if the payment fails', **ଓଟିପି ନ ଆସିଲେ** 'if the OTP doesn't come', **କ୍ୟାସ୍ ଦେଲେ ବି ଚଳିବ** 'cash is fine too'.

vocab.note: ୟୁପିଆଇ କରିବା 'to pay by UPI'. People also name the app: ଫୋନପେ / ଜିପେ କରିଦିଅ.
ପେମେଣ୍ଟ କରିବା 'to pay'; ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହେବା 'to go through'.
Stuck on every shop counter and street cart in Odisha.
ଡାଟା ସରିଗଲା 'the data's run out'; ଡାଟା ଅନ୍ କରିବା 'to turn on data'.

vocab.en: (of a phone or app) freezing, hanging

vocab.note: ଡେଲିଭରି ହେବା 'to be delivered'; the delivery person is often ଡେଲିଭରି ବାଲା.
କ୍ୟାନସେଲ୍ କରିବା 'to cancel'; କ୍ୟାନସେଲ୍ ହେବା 'to get cancelled'. Odia: ବାତିଲ (unit 19).
ଫ୍ରଡ୍ ହେବା 'to be scammed'; the Odia word is ଠକେଇ.
ଷ୍ଟେଟସରେ ଦେବା 'to put on your status'.

phrases.en: Can I pay by UPI? (lit. will UPI do?)
Could you show me the QR code?
The payment's gone through — have a look.
Shall I pay cash or UPI?
Track where the order's got to.

phrases.en: The money has been debited, but it says the payment failed.

phrases.native: ଏ ଲିଙ୍କ୍ ଖୋଲ ନାହିଁ, ଫ୍ରଡ୍ ହୋଇପାରେ।

phrases.en: Don't open this link — it could be a scam.

grammar.title: English word + Odia verb: କରିବା or ହେବା?
grammar.body:
Almost all tech vocabulary in Odia is English, but an English word can't be the verb of an Odia sentence. It always comes with an **Odia verb**, and choosing that verb is the grammar.

**କରିବା — someone does it** (transitive; the person is the subject):
ମୁଁ ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ **କଲି** 'I downloaded the app' · ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **କରନ୍ତୁ** 'please pay' · କ୍ୟୁଆର୍ କୋଡ୍ ସ୍କାନ୍ **କର** 'scan the QR code' · ପୋଷ୍ଟ ସେୟାର୍ **କରିଦିଅ** 'share the post'.

**ହେବା — it happens** (intransitive; the thing is the subject):
ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ **ହେଉଛି** 'the app is downloading' · ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **ହୋଇଗଲା** 'the payment went through' · ଫୋନ ହ୍ୟାଙ୍ଗ୍ **ହେଉଛି** 'the phone keeps freezing' · ଅର୍ଡର କ୍ୟାନସେଲ୍ **ହେଲା** 'the order got cancelled' · ରିଲ୍ ଭାଇରାଲ୍ **ହୋଇଗଲା** 'the reel went viral'.
This is the same pair you met in unit 25 (ଠିକ୍ କରିବା / ଠିକ୍ ହେବା), now applied to everything.

**Other everyday partners:** **ଚାଲିବା** 'run, work' — ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ **ଚାଲୁନି**; **ସରିବା** 'run out' — ଡାଟା **ସରିଗଲା**; **ଆସିବା** 'come' — ଓଟିପି **ଆସିଲା ନାହିଁ**; **ଦେଖାଇବା** 'show' (what the screen says) — ଫେଲ୍ **ଦେଖାଉଛି** 'it says failed'; **ନେବା** — ସ୍କ୍ରିନସଟ୍ **ନେବା**; **ଦେବା** — ଷ୍ଟେଟସରେ **ଦେବା** 'put on status'.

Everything you know about Odia verbs now works on the Odia half: compounds (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ **କରିଦେଲି** 'I've gone and downloaded it', ଅପଡେଟ୍ **ହୋଇଯିବ** 'it'll get updated'), ability (ଲଗଇନ୍ **କରିପାରୁନି** 'I can't log in'), the -ଇ participle (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ **କରି** ଲଗଇନ୍ କର 'download and then log in').

**The trap:** the two verbs mean different things, so mixing them changes who did it: ମୁଁ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **କରିଦେଲି** 'I've paid (I did my part)' vs ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **ହୋଇଗଲା** 'the payment has gone through (it worked)'. A shopkeeper waiting for money wants to hear the second. And never leave the English word on its own as a verb: ~~ମୁଁ ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍~~ → ମୁଁ ଆପ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ **କଲି**.

examples.en: Download the app and log in.
I've paid — I'm sending you the screenshot.
I can't log in — I've forgotten the password.

grammar.title: Real conditionals in practice: -ଲେ, ନ -ଲେ, -ଲେ ବି, ନହେଲେ
grammar.body:
Unit 19 introduced the **-ଲେ** form for 'if'. In everyday money-and-phone talk you'll use it constantly. The patterns that matter:

**If:** verb-**ଲେ** + result (future, command, or a general truth): ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଫେଲ୍ **ହେଲେ** ଟଙ୍କା ଫେରିଆସିବ 'if the payment fails, the money will come back'. The -ଲେ form **never changes for person**: ମୁଁ / ତୁମେ / ସେ ଦେଲେ.

**If not:** **ନ** + verb-ଲେ, written as two words: ଓଟିପି **ନ ଆସିଲେ** ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କର 'if the OTP doesn't come, try again'.

**Otherwise / or else:** **ନହେଲେ** (one word): ଲିଙ୍କ୍ ଖୋଲ ନାହିଁ, **ନହେଲେ** ଟଙ୍କା ଚାଲିଯିବ.

**Even if / … too:** -ଲେ + **ବି**: କ୍ୟାସ୍ ଦେଲେ **ବି** ଚଳିବ 'cash is fine too' (lit. even if you give cash, it'll do); ଅଫର୍ ଥିଲେ **ବି** ଦାମୀ 'even with the offer it's expensive'.

**Once / when** (about the future): the same -ଲେ: ପାର୍ସଲ୍ ଆସିଲେ ମୋତେ ଜଣାଇବ 'let me know when the parcel arrives'.

**Whether … or not:** … **କି ନାହିଁ**: ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହେଲା କି ନାହିଁ ଦେଖ 'check whether the payment went through'.

**ଯଦି … ତେବେ** is still there for emphasis and in formal messages from banks and companies (ଯଦି ଆପଣ … , ତେବେ …), but in speech the -ଲେ clause on its own, placed **first**, is normal.

**The trap:** don't put a tense ending on the 'if' verb: ~~ଫେଲ୍ ହେବ ଯଦି~~, ~~ନ ଆସିଲା ତେବେ~~ → ଫେଲ୍ **ହେଲେ**, ନ **ଆସିଲେ**. And in 'if not', ନ comes right before the verb, after any English word: ଅପଡେଟ୍ **ନ କଲେ**, not ~~ନ ଅପଡେଟ୍ କଲେ~~.

examples.en: If the OTP doesn't come, try again.

examples.en: Don't open links from strangers, or the money will disappear from your account.

examples.en: Even with the offer, this phone is really expensive.
Let me know when the parcel arrives.

dialogue.title: Biryani in the rain
dialogue.setting: A rainy evening in a rented flat in Saheed Nagar, Bhubaneswar. Ankit and his elder sister Smruti share the flat; as siblings they use ତୁ.

lines.native: ଅପା, ୱାଇଫାଇ ଚାଲୁନି କି? ମୋ ଫୋନରେ କିଛି ଲୋଡ୍ ହେଉନି।

lines.speaker: Smruti
lines.native: ହଁ, ଦୁଇଟା। ଅଫର୍ ଦେଖ, କିଛି କ୍ୟାସବ୍ୟାକ୍ ମିଳିଲେ ଭଲ।

lines.speaker: Ankit

lines.speaker: Ankit

lines.speaker: Ankit
lines.native: ତୁ ଆଉ ତୋ ରିଲ୍! ମୋତେ ଟ୍ୟାଗ୍ କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ, ମୁଁ ଲୁଙ୍ଗିରେ ଅଛି।

lines.en: You and your reels! Don't tag me — I'm in my lungi.

lines.speaker: Smruti
lines.native: ହା ହା! ଆଚ୍ଛା, ଡେଲିଭରି ହେଲେ ମୋତେ ଡାକିବୁ।

culture:
UPI has reached every corner of Odisha: the gupchup cart, the vegetable seller at the haat and the temple flower stall all have a **QR code**, often with a little speaker box that announces each payment out loud. People say **ୟୁପିଆଇ କରିଦିଅ** or name the app — **ଫୋନପେ କରିଦିଅ**, **ଜିପେ କରନ୍ତୁ**. Still, keep some cash: networks drop during storms and cyclones, and in villages and on buses cash is king.

Food-delivery apps work across Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Berhampur and Rourkela; online shopping reaches small towns, and **cash on delivery** is still popular. Addresses are loose, so people add a **landmark** ('behind the Hanuman temple', 'opposite the big banyan tree') and expect a call from the delivery rider.

On WhatsApp and Instagram, many young people type Odia in **Roman letters** and mix freely with English and a bit of Hindi; Odia reels, film songs and comedy pages are hugely popular. Family WhatsApp groups are full of good-morning images and festival greetings.

Scams are a real problem: fake 'KYC update' messages, prize links and calls pretending to be from the bank. The rule everyone repeats: **ଓଟିପି କାହାକୁ କହିବ ନାହିଁ** — never tell anyone your OTP; the bank never asks for it. India's cyber-fraud helpline is **1930**.

tip.title: English word + କରିବା or ହେବା
tip.body:
- **କରିବା** when *you* do it: ସ୍କାନ୍ **କରୁଛି**, ୟୁପିଆଇ **କରିଦେଲି**.
- **ହେବା** when *it* happens: ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **ହୋଇଗଲା**, ପେମେଣ୍ଟ **ହେଉନି**.
- ମୁଁ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ କରିଦେଲି 'I've paid' ≠ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହୋଇଗଲା 'it went through'.
tip.pattern: person + English word + କରିବା  ·  thing + English word + ହେବା

sentences.native: ମୁଁ କ୍ୟୁଆର୍ କୋଡ୍ ସ୍କାନ୍ କରୁଛି, ଟିକେ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।

sentences.native: ଭାଇ, ଏକଶହ ଟଙ୍କା ୟୁପିଆଇ କରିଦେଲି।

sentences.en: Bhai, I've sent you a hundred rupees by UPI.

sentences.native: ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟରେ ବାଲାନ୍ସ କମ, ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହେଉନି।

tip.title: Saying it's not working
tip.body:
- **ଚାଲୁନି** 'isn't working' (careful: ଚାଲୁ ନାହିଁ): ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ଚାଲୁନି.
- Thing + **ହେଉନି**: ଲୋଡ୍ ହେଉନି, ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ହେଉନି.
- 'I can't': **-ଇ ପାରୁନି** — ଲଗଇନ୍ କରିପାରୁନି.
- Run out: **ସରିଗଲା** — ଡାଟା ସରିଗଲା.
tip.pattern: thing + ଚାଲୁନି / ହେଉନି  ·  ମୁଁ + verb-ଇ + ପାରୁନି

lessons.title: Ordering online

tip.title: If, if not, even if: -ଲେ
tip.body:
- If: verb-**ଲେ** — ଫେଲ୍ **ହେଲେ**, ଅଫର୍ **ଥିଲେ**. It never changes for person.
- If not: **ନ** + verb-ଲେ — ନ **ଆସିଲେ**.
- Even if / … too: -ଲେ **ବି** — କ୍ୟାସ୍ ଦେଲେ ବି ଚଳିବ.
- Once (future): ଡେଲିଭରି **ହେଲେ** ଜଣାଇବ.
tip.pattern: verb-ଲେ + result  ·  ନ + verb-ଲେ  ·  verb-ଲେ ବି
